items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports; same left knee as prior PCL sprain/bone bruise. Scary history but realistic W2 possibility. HC now calls day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim; Schefter realistic one-game miss; Kubiak day-to-day
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 upside if active, Mayer fills otherwise

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Harbaugh. Status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders; will monitor how he feels this week. Left early W1.
items.implication: Potential miss opens slot/role for others; Tre Harris beneficiary per ETR

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers left W1 early with hamstring injury not considered serious. Day-to-day; MRI upcoming but would have returned if playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.implication: Likely plays or limited; Bateman/Lane/Moore upside if out

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week after solid W1 (6-48-1) and with De'Zhaun Stribling sidelined (sprain, weeks).
items.why: Stribling injury opens role in Shanahan offense; versatile usage

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve and signed RB Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad.
items.implication: Judkins primary but low routes (13/30); Sanders also got work

items.text: Week 2 waivers highlight injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; A.J. Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Sanders. Plus streamers Wentz/Shough, Vele, etc.
items.why: Precise injury fallout and FAAB/streaming guidance

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9 (2.5 last night); just 2 targets for 7% share but ran 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy's 30). Needs serious volume to produce despite route participation.
items.why: High routes but tiny aDOT and low target share in debut

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role confirmed.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving usage in new offense
items.implication: Lock-in high-end RB1 with massive opportunity share

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps Etienne 53, Kendre Miller 26, CJ Donaldson 15; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne lead but Miller handcuff/value; Kamara return looming

items.text: Malik Nabers logs an encouraging return in Week 1 per ETR team-by-team recap with Levitan/Silva.
Eagles officially placed G Landon Dickerson on IR (knee); misses at least next four games. Signed Britain Covey to active roster.
items.implication: OL hit could affect Hurts/Barkley efficiency slightly

items.text: Justin Boone Week 2 waivers: Kaelon Black, Denzel Boston, Kenyon Sadiq, Devaughn Vele, Dontayvion Wicks, Bryce Young among top; Coker would be #1 if available (61% rostered). Updated post-MNF.
Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No. 1 RB Utilization Score (99) in Week 1 per Fantasy Life report; ascends to high-end RB1.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) went down early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Limited route participation despite injury ahead
items.implication: Passing-game role capped; more runner than receiver
